content: Create a wide cinematic fantasy sci-fi cityscape at night: an elegant futuristic utopian metropolis made of smooth white organic architecture, sweeping shell-like buildings, ribbed biomorphic towers, arched skybridges, and layered elevated roads curving through the scene. The city should feel vast and luminous, with approximately three dominant foreground megastructures: one large cropped shell-like building on the left, one tall twisting tower-building on the right, and one lower pavilion-like structure in the lower right; include many smaller spires and towers receding into the misty center background. Use {argument name="architectural style" default="white biomorphic solarpunk futurism inspired by shells, bones, and flowing parametric design"}. Add a narrow river or canal winding from the foreground into the center distance, bordered by terraces, bridges, gardens, and softly lit pedestrian paths. Include clusters of pale trees and landscaped parks throughout the city, glowing warm interior windows, delicate dotted facade textures, and tiny human figures for scale. The sky is deep blue-black with a bright full moon near the upper left-center, faint stars, and drifting mist. Color palette: cool moonlit silver, pearl white, icy blue-gray, and warm champagne lights. Lighting should be dreamy and high-detail, with soft volumetric haze, reflective water, crisp architectural surfaces, and an ethereal peaceful atmosphere. Use a panoramic 16:9 composition, ultra-detailed digital concept art, cinematic depth, no text, no logos, no vehicles dominating the scene.

Create a dramatic fashion-editorial poster of a gritty wandering samurai holding a katana diagonally across the body. The subject is a single half-body figure with messy black hair tied in a loose topknot, windblown strands, rugged layered dark gray-black robes, dirty weathered fabric, frayed sleeves, leather cords at the waist, and a battle-worn metal katana with an ornate black-and-gold wrapped handle and round guard. The face must be obscured by a centered opaque square censor block in warm dark brown, covering the facial features while leaving hair, ear, hand, clothing, and sword visible. Compose the figure inside a bold abstract diagonal hot-pink slash shape on a clean white background, with sharp white geometric cutouts crossing the image so the pink shape feels like a large angular lightning-bolt or folded ribbon. Use high-contrast photorealistic detail, gritty texture, ink splatters and grime around the figure, strong daylight, crisp shadows, and a magazine-cover/poster aesthetic. The katana blade should run from the upper left handle area down toward the lower right foreground, long and reflective, dominating the composition. Add a small handwritten signature/date note in the bottom-right white margin reading {argument name="date text" default="May 28, 2026"} on the first line and {argument name="signature text" default="Oyagi"} on the second line. Keep the canvas vertical 2:3, minimal, no other text, no border, no watermark.

Create a moody cinematic square portrait of {argument name="character description" default="a young Japanese schoolgirl"} sitting alone on a train or bus on a rainy day, leaning her head against a fogged window covered in raindrops and condensation. She has long wet-looking black hair falling over her shoulders and wears a white sailor-style school uniform with a dark navy collar and ribbon tie. The composition is close and intimate, with the window occupying the left half of the frame and the girl on the right, her posture tired and melancholic as she looks downward toward the glass. Add exactly one large opaque square censor block over the center of her face, colored muted dark brown-gray, hiding all facial features. Outside the window, show a soft blurred green countryside landscape under overcast gray weather. Use natural low-light photography, shallow depth of field, muted green and gray tones, realistic rain droplets on glass, soft film grain, emotional rainy-day atmosphere, and a 1:1 aspect ratio. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.

Create a polished product mockup showing a cozy winter campfire wallpaper adapted across three Apple-style devices. The wallpaper illustration should resemble a cute Japanese crayon-anime style without logos: five small cartoon children and one small white dog gathered around a bright campfire in a snowy pine forest at night, with falling snow, deep navy-blue trees, warm orange firelight illuminating the characters and snow, and a soft magical winter atmosphere. The main character is a round-faced child in a red winter sweater standing behind the fire, surrounded by four friends: one with dark spiky hair on the left, one in a brown coat at lower left, one curly-haired child in pink on the right, and one child in a green hood at lower right; the white dog sleeps or curls up near the fire in front. Show exactly three devices on a light gray studio background, each inside a rounded white display card with soft shadows: one large laptop mockup centered at the top, one tablet mockup at bottom left, and one smartphone mockup at bottom right. On all screens, display the same wallpaper composition, cropped appropriately. Add realistic lock-screen UI overlays: large time {argument name="time" default="9:38"}, date {argument name="date" default="Friday, November 15"}, small status icons, and subtle translucent widgets. The tablet should include a translucent weather widget on the upper left showing {argument name="weather location" default="Cupertino"} and {argument name="temperature" default="45°"}; the phone should include three circular widgets below the time and two small bottom lock-screen icons. Use clean high-end Apple product rendering, black bezels, thin device frames, rounded corners, soft ambient shadows, sharp screen detail, and a balanced wallpaper-preview layout suitable for desktop, tablet, and mobile backgrounds. Avoid brand logos, watermarks, extra text, or additional devices.

Create a full-body tokusatsu-style enemy monster suit character on a clean white studio background, centered and isolated like a production design render. The creature is a music-themed villain named {argument name="character name" default="Violin Phantom"}, combining an armored humanoid kaijin with an ornate violin and classical music motifs. It wears ivory-white, aged bone-like armor with antique gold trim, black ribbed undersuit fabric, and dark weathered creases, with a dramatic silhouette of sharp curled shoulder plates and flared skirt armor. The head and torso are shaped like a vertical violin: the face is hidden behind a violin-body helmet with two narrow glowing yellow eyes, black f-hole-like openings, vertical strings running down the front, and a tall violin neck rising from the crown with tuning pegs. Use exactly 2 visible eyes, 4 tuning pegs on the head instrument, 2 large curled shoulder plates, 2 black gloved hands, 2 armored legs, and 1 large ornate musical staff weapon. The left hand is raised open in a theatrical villain gesture, palm facing outward; the right hand holds a tall staff topped with a golden treble clef inside a circular lyre-like frame with horizontal strings. The armor includes engraved musical staff lines and note patterns on the thighs and shin guards, curling gold scrollwork on the chest, hanging gold bead ornaments at the waist, pointed curled boots, and layered asymmetrical plates with a worn ceramic texture. Style should feel like a practical Japanese special-effects monster costume from a superhero TV series, highly detailed, realistic materials, dramatic but evenly lit product photography, crisp edges, no environment, no text, no watermark. Use {argument name="armor color" default="aged ivory white"} armor, {argument name="metal trim color" default="antique gold"} trim, {argument name="eye color" default="glowing yellow"} eyes, and a {argument name="weapon motif" default="treble clef lyre staff"}.

Create a full-body tokusatsu-style enemy kaijin monster suit that looks like a humanoid made from a vintage car, standing in a dynamic studio character render on a plain white background. The villain should be centered, facing forward in a powerful action pose with one clawed hand reaching toward the viewer and the other arm bent outward. Use a bulky practical-suit aesthetic with glossy hard armor, rubbery black undersuit joints, and exaggerated monster proportions. The torso is the front half of an old sedan: silver hood and fenders as chest armor, large chrome grille in the center, two round headlights, bumper pieces, dark windshield panels forming the upper shoulders, and worn red flame-like paint streaks over chipped silver metal. The head is a sinister car-themed skull helmet above the hood, with glowing red eyes, a vertical chrome grille mouth, angular cheek spikes, side fins, and a red mohawk-like fin on top. Include exactly 6 visible wheel elements: 1 spare tire mounted near the right shoulder, 1 wheel on the right thigh/hip area, 1 wheel on the left outer thigh, 1 wheel on the right shin, and 2 partially visible tire-like wheel details integrated into the torso/arm structure. The arms are armored with car body panels and end in sharp silver talons; add red-and-silver spiked cuffs, with exactly 5 claws visible on the forward left hand and exactly 4 claws visible on the right hand. The legs are black ribbed mechanical suit material with silver knee armor, red flame-painted shin guards, chunky monster boots, and metallic toe claws. Add a circular belt emblem at the waist like a nautical steering-wheel gear medallion in blue and gold. Color palette: weathered silver chrome, black rubber, blood red paint, dark shadows, and small gold headlight accents. Render as a high-detail realistic action figure / practical monster costume photo, dramatic but clean studio lighting, crisp edges, no text, no logo, no scenery, no watermark. Optional customization: make the monster theme {argument name="monster theme" default="vintage car kaijin"}, main armor color {argument name="main armor color" default="weathered silver chrome"}, accent paint color {argument name="accent paint color" default="blood red flame streaks"}, eye color {argument name="eye color" default="glowing red"}, background {argument name="background" default="plain white studio background"}.

Goal: Create a dramatic two-panel Japanese fantasy manga comparison comic about how large damage numbers make combat feel more satisfying, even when the time required is the same.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, full-color manga illustration with thick black comic borders, dynamic speed lines, explosive impact effects, and a black brushstroke title banner at the top. Overall style should be detailed dark-fantasy shonen manga with bold outlined lettering.

Layout: Use exactly 2 wide horizontal comic panels stacked vertically. Add a black brushstroke header above both panels containing the title text {argument name="title text" default="『かかる時間は同じでも……』"}. Each panel has the same party of 3 heroes on the left and 1 enemy on the right, with a vertical white narration box on the far right.

Characters: The hero party appears in both panels and contains exactly 3 visible characters: 1 young male swordsman in blue armor holding a sword, 1 young female witch in a purple robe and pointed hat, and 1 small green-haired healer or cleric holding a staff. Their faces may be partially obscured or softly blurred, but their poses and outfits remain readable. Top panel enemy: 1 enormous black armored knight/golem with a shield and heavy plate armor, standing on the right. Bottom panel enemy: 1 enormous bare-chested muscular barbarian/giant with rough skin, leather/fur waist gear, and clenched fists, standing on the right.

Top panel text and effects: Include exactly 2 white speech bubbles from the heroes: 「これも効かないの!?」 and 「どうしたらいいんだよコイツ!」. Include exactly 1 vertical narration box on the right reading 「耐性がカッチカチ、よりも」. Add exactly 4 small blue damage numbers around the armored enemy: 「10!」, 「10!」, 「12!」, and 「12!」.

Bottom panel text and effects: Include exactly 2 white speech bubbles from the heroes: 「こいつ、まだ立ち向かってくる……!」 and 「なんてタフなんだ!」. Include exactly 1 vertical narration box on the right reading 「HPモリモリの方が」. Add exactly 2 huge fiery red-orange damage numbers: 「1012!」 near the center-left and 「2001!」 near the right. At the bottom, spanning across the lower panel, place a large energetic slogan in thick yellow-orange Japanese brush lettering with black outline: {argument name="bottom slogan" default="数字がでっかくて楽しい!"}.

Visual style: High contrast, gritty fantasy lighting, dramatic explosions behind enemies, manga hatching, saturated impact colors, thick white speech bubbles with black outlines, bold 3D comic typography for numbers. Make the top panel feel frustrating and low-impact with small blue numbers; make the bottom panel feel exciting and powerful with huge warm-colored numbers.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 panels, exactly 4 total main characters per panel, exactly 4 small damage numbers in the top panel, exactly 2 large damage numbers in the bottom panel, exactly 4 total speech bubbles, exactly 2 vertical narration boxes, and 1 large bottom slogan. Keep all visible Japanese text legible and avoid adding extra text or watermarks.

Create a full-body studio character portrait of a tokusatsu-style enemy monster villain, standing in a wide aggressive stance on a plain white background. The character is a bizarre haute-couture sewing/dressmaker kaijin named {argument name="character name" default="the tailor demon"}, combining glossy black insectoid armor with Victorian gothic fashion. The figure has a black masked face with narrow red eyes, a tall beige dress form mannequin headpiece laced down the front with black cord, and a dramatic high flared collar lined in quilted {argument name="accent color" default="dusty pink"}. The outfit is an elaborate black leather and lace dress with cream corset panels, gold buttons, black lace trim, chains, heart charms, safety-pin details, measuring-tape ribbons, bows, and patchwork skirt panels. Use a palette of {argument name="main colors" default="black, cream, dusty pink, gold, and houndstooth beige"}, with glossy rubber, leather, metal, lace, and fabric textures. Show exactly 6 prominent costume ornaments on the skirt and waist: 1 large pink thread spool across the waist, 1 dangling beige price tag reading "SIZE / FREE", 1 small round pocket watch charm, 1 gold heart lock charm, 1 beige dress-form charm, and 1 pink bow. The left hand holds a giant black tailor scissor weapon with two long curved blades, while the right hand reaches forward with five clawed black fingers tipped in gold. Add spiked shoulders, studded forearms, thigh-high black boots with gold buttons, and a layered skirt made of glossy black triangular panels plus a visible houndstooth front panel. The lighting should be crisp catalog-style, highly detailed practical suit photography, as if a real special-effects monster costume from a Japanese hero TV show, no environment, no text except the small tag.

Using the provided reference image as the base, transform the scene into a dramatic nocturnal version while preserving the snow leopard’s airborne leap, the snowy cliff setting, the vertical poster composition, and the painterly fantasy-realism detail. Change the warm golden palette into a cold deep-blue moonlit atmosphere, replace the gold sun/planet backdrop with a small realistic full moon in the upper right, and make the leopard appear more front-facing and confident as it springs forward toward the viewer. Add icy rim lighting around the fur, sharper blue eyes, wind-swept white motion trails, snow spray, mist, and darker high-contrast snowy mountain peaks below. Keep the ornate textured background feel but make it subtle and dark, with no text, watermark, or extra animals. Render in crisp {argument name="resolution" default="4K"} quality, cinematic fantasy wildlife art, highly detailed fur, dramatic lighting, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

Create a polished anime fantasy illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a cheerful young female hero"} in a Dragon Quest-inspired adventurer outfit, shown in a dynamic low-angle three-quarter pose on a sunlit stone castle wall. She has long flowing {argument name="hair color" default="soft pastel pink"} hair with a side braid and wind-swept strands, large sparkling crimson-pink eyes, a gentle confident smile, and a gold circlet headpiece with one blue jewel centered on her forehead. Her outfit has exactly these visible main pieces: one royal blue sleeveless tunic dress with gold trim and a gold winged crest with a red gem on the chest, one white blouse underneath with puffed sleeves, one deep red cape fastened at the collar with a round red gemstone brooch, one brown leather belt with gold buckle, one small brown leather pouch hanging at the waist, one short white ruffled underskirt, two brown leather gauntlets, and two tall brown adventurer boots. She holds exactly one silver sword thrust diagonally toward the viewer in her right hand, with a gold crossguard and red gemstone, and exactly one blue-and-gold shield on her left arm with a matching gold crest and red gem. In the background, include exactly one tall fairytale castle with blue spires on the right, exactly one red medieval banner with a gold emblem on the left, distant green mountains and valley, bright blue sky, fluffy white clouds, sparkling sun rays, and a heroic high-fantasy atmosphere. Use vibrant cel-shaded anime rendering with soft painterly highlights, crisp linework, glossy jewel details, dramatic foreshortening on the sword, wind motion in the hair and cape, and a vertical portrait composition. Keep the image clean, cute, adventurous, highly detailed, and text-free.

Create a highly detailed vertical anime-style illustration of an elegant adult woman, {argument name="character name" default="a refined married woman"}, shown from behind in a three-quarter over-the-shoulder pose inside a warmly lit luxurious interior. She has glossy {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair gathered into a loose low bun at the nape, with soft wispy strands around the neck and side of the face, strong rim lighting outlining individual hairs. Her face is intentionally hidden by a large centered opaque rectangular privacy block in a muted brown skin-tone gradient, covering the entire facial area from forehead to chin. She wears a sophisticated {argument name="dress color" default="black"} satin dress with a high glossy collar, soft puffed sleeves, and a sheer lace panel across the upper back and shoulders; the lace has delicate dark floral embroidery visible against her skin. The composition is intimate and cinematic, with the woman occupying most of the frame, shoulders and back in focus, head turned slightly to the right. Use dramatic golden backlight from tall windows or lamps, warm bokeh highlights in the background, shallow depth of field, realistic fabric sheen, fine hair detail, elegant mature atmosphere, painterly high-end anime rendering, soft contrast, no text, no watermark.

Create an elegant vertical foil-stamped collectible postcard on a dark velvet tabletop. The card should feature a dreamy anime-style girl illustration framed inside an ornate arched window cutout, with layered cream cardstock, pearlescent lavender ink, embossed silver and holographic foil details, and delicate raised borders. The central character is {argument name="character name" default="Nozomu"}, a young woman shown from the back and slightly turned over her shoulder, wearing an off-shoulder white ruffled dress, with {argument name="hair color" default="soft ash-blonde"} wavy hair gathered into a loose side bun, small blue floral hair ornaments, glowing skin, and a romantic twilight garden background with a balcony railing, tiny stars, bokeh lights, leaves, and purple-blue flowers. Keep the face area softly obscured or left blank if a personalized portrait is not provided. Add ornate decorative elements around the frame: exactly 1 large ribbon bow at the upper right, 1 crescent moon near the top center, 1 title plaque at the top, 1 large name plaque at the bottom, 2 large sweeping lavender foil arcs, 4 faceted gemstone ornaments, multiple tiny star sparkles, and a floral cluster at the lower left with roses, leaves, and small blue flowers. Text content: top plaque reads {argument name="top title text" default="Twilight of Glow"}; bottom large Japanese name reads {argument name="main name text" default="のぞむ"}; small subtitle beneath reads {argument name="subtitle text" default="きらめきは、静かな夜に咲く。"}; tiny serial text at the bottom reads "NO.24  TG 0731". Surround the postcard with luxury props: a glass star ornament in the upper left, pale pink flowers in the upper right, a gold frame edge at the lower left, and translucent ribbon with a dangling crystal charm at the lower right. Use a soft angled product-photo perspective, shallow depth of field, warm highlights, cool lavender shadows, premium paper texture, crisp embossing, iridescent foil shine, and a refined magical-girl stationery aesthetic. Avoid extra text, watermarks, logos, or additional characters.

Goal: Create a vertical Japanese travel magazine cover for {argument name="destination" default="Nagoya"}, with an airy, nostalgic weekend-trip mood aimed at young women.

Canvas: Portrait magazine cover, 4:5 aspect ratio, full-bleed photographic design. Bright clear blue sky, soft sunlight, clean editorial layout, high-resolution lifestyle travel photography with a slightly dreamy commercial magazine finish.

Main image: Use Nagoya Castle as the large background landmark on the upper-right and center, slightly softened by depth of field but recognizable with white walls and green roofs. In the foreground, place exactly 2 young adult women travelers standing side by side on a bridge or promenade with ornate green railing; both are fashionably dressed in light spring clothing. Woman 1 wears an ivory knit top and long white skirt with a beige shoulder bag, holding a drink or small item. Woman 2 wears a white button-up blouse and pale blue skirt with a beige tote bag. Both faces may be softly obscured or not emphasized. Add lush green trees behind them and a fresh blue-sky atmosphere.

Typography and text content: Make the cover look like a Japanese travel magazine with large elegant white and pink type over the sky. Include exactly 9 main text areas: 1) small top-left line 「週末に行きたい、とっておき名古屋」, 2) huge white title 「名古屋、」, 3) huge pink brush-style title 「ふたり旅。」, 4) English subtitle “NAGOYA TRIP”, 5) top-right magazine label “PHOTO & TRAVEL MAGAZINE” plus “2024-2025” and 「旅の記憶を、一生の宝物に。」, 6) circular stamp near the castle reading “LOVE NAGOYA” with Japanese text 「女子旅で見つけるときめき BEST SPOTS」, 7) left feature block with pink headline 「快晴の城下町さんぽ」 and smaller Japanese copy about Nagoya Castle, Meijo Park, and Osu shopping street, 8) left feature block with pink headline 「映える街角とご当地グルメ」 and smaller Japanese copy about hitsumabushi, miso katsu, and Ogura toast, 9) left feature block with pink headline 「心ときめくフォトジェニック旅」 and smaller Japanese copy about colorful moments and favorite spots. Add a vertical white poetic caption on the right side: 「青空の下で、いちばん素敵な思い出を」. Add a handwritten white script near the lower-right main photo reading “It’s time to discover Nagoya!”

Bottom collage: Along the bottom edge, overlay exactly 4 tilted postcard-style photos with white borders and subtle shadows: 1) Nagoya TV Tower / Oasis 21 style modern city landmark with flowers in foreground, 2) close-up of hitsumabushi eel rice set with side dishes, 3) red Osu shopping arcade entrance with large lanterns reading 「大須」, 4) Ogura toast dessert with red cherry and coffee. Add exactly 4 small tape-label captions around the collage: 「美しい景色と、美味しい時間。」, 「名古屋で見つけた、私たちの特別。」, 「歩いて、食べて、笑って。」, and 「ふたりだから、もっと楽しい。」

Visual style: Japanese women’s travel magazine cover, elegant editorial composition, soft pastel palette of sky blue, white, blush pink, beige, and fresh green. Mix sharp foreground photography with gently blurred background landmark depth. Use refined Mincho-style Japanese typography for the large title, pink brush lettering for the travel phrase, and small neat serif/sans-serif editorial text.

Constraints: Preserve the exact count of 2 women, 4 bottom postcard photos, 9 main text areas, and 4 small collage captions. Keep all Japanese text legible and placed like a real magazine cover. No extra logos, barcodes, QR codes, watermarks, or unrelated text.

Goal: Create a vertical Japanese travel-magazine poster for a sunny afternoon trip in Nagoya, combining realistic photography with elegant editorial typography.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, bright midday lighting, clear blue sky, thin double-line gold border near the edges, polished tourism brochure look.

Main scene: Show exactly 2 young adult women standing in the foreground on a clean stone walkway, faces softly blurred/anonymized. Woman 1 on the left has dark hair in a loose bun, wears a cream button-up shirt and an olive-green long skirt, and holds a brown notebook against her chest. Woman 2 on the right has long dark hair, wears a blue denim jacket over a white top with light blue jeans, holds a takeaway coffee cup in one hand and a small shopping bag in the other. They look like friends sightseeing together.

Background landmarks: Include exactly 3 prominent Nagoya sightseeing elements: 1) Nagoya Castle on the left with green tiled roofs and gold details, 2) a tall modern TV tower-like structure in the right-center background, 3) a glass-domed Oasis 21-style roof structure on the right above a reflecting pool. Add manicured greenery, hydrangea flowers, trees, and a clean urban park atmosphere.

Text layout: Use elegant black Japanese serif typography with subtle white glow for the main title. Add decorative gold leaf/flourish ornaments near the title and small gold accent lines around side text blocks. Include exactly 6 text areas: 1) large top headline {argument name="headline text" default="名古屋の午後"}, 2) centered subtitle below it {argument name="subtitle text" default="〜晴れの日、二人の旅〜"}, 3) vertical left text near the castle {argument name="left feature text" default="名古屋城の美しさを、お昼の光で★"}, 4) right feature text near the tower and dome {argument name="right feature text" default="Hisaya Odori Parkの緑と歴史\nOasis 21と未来を感じる景色\n二人で歩く、名古屋の柔らかい一日"}, 5) lower-left lunch text {argument name="lunch text" default="ランチタイムに出会う、街の魅力\nおすすめカフェと観光スポットをご紹介"}, 6) bottom centered issue label reading "NAGOYA PHOTO COLLECTION" and "Vol. 07".

Style constraints: Photorealistic travel poster, natural proportions, crisp architecture, soft editorial color grading, no cartoon style, no extra people, no extra text beyond the 6 specified text areas, keep the Japanese text visually vertical where shown on the sides, and maintain a premium magazine-cover composition.

Create an ultra-detailed kawaii anime-style decorated icing cookie photographed from above on an ornate cream lace doily. The cookie is a single large scalloped rectangular sugar cookie with a golden-brown baked edge and thick glossy royal icing relief, like edible 3D sugar art. The design shows {argument name="character name" default="a faceless blonde anime girl"} sitting curled up with knees raised, wearing an oversized pastel {argument name="jacket color" default="powder blue"} jacket decorated with tiny icing flowers, a white shirt, pale cream shorts, and shiny {argument name="boot color" default="deep blue"} lace-up combat boots with thick soles. Her face is intentionally covered by a plain peach square placeholder, while long pale blonde icing hair flows around it in many piped strands with two braids and small blue flower accents. She holds one vertical transparent-looking icing tube or wand filled with tiny pastel flower and pearl candies. The background icing on the cookie is soft sky blue with glossy pink heart decorations, white sparkle stars, pearl dots, and delicate sugar-bead accents. Use exactly these main decorative counts: 1 seated girl figure, 1 face-covering peach square, 2 long braids, 1 candy-filled vertical wand, 3 visible pink hearts on the blue background plus 1 large central heart, 2 blue boots, and numerous small piped flowers and pearls. Surround the cookie with soft-focus pearls, pink beads, a pale pink satin ribbon bow, and intricate cream lace details. Visual style: macro food photography, pastel colors, glossy royal icing texture, highly dimensional piping, cute handmade confectionery, soft diffused lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic edible cookie materials, vertical 3:4 composition, no text, no watermark.

Create a surreal high-fashion studio editorial photograph featuring {argument name="model description" default="a glamorous young woman with long dark wavy hair and warm medium skin"} seated on a plush pink faux-fur armchair in an all-pink fur-lined set. She wears an oversized voluminous {argument name="coat color and material" default="bubblegum pink faux-fur coat"} draped around her body, bare legs crossed elegantly, and sparkling pink pointed stiletto heels. She holds a clear glass bottle filled with milk in both hands at her lap and looks calmly into the camera with a poised fashion-model expression. Beside her, a {argument name="animal model" default="cream-colored calf"} leans in from the right, resting its head affectionately on the chair arm and close to her shoulder; show the animal’s full head, neck, torso, and front legs, natural and realistic. The entire environment is monochrome pink: fuzzy wall backdrop, fuzzy floor, and rounded furry chair, with rich tactile texture everywhere. Use glossy magazine fashion photography styling, surreal luxury dairy concept, soft yet directional studio lighting from upper left, gentle shadows, warm highlights on skin and fur, shallow depth of field, realistic proportions, high detail, shot on a {argument name="lens" default="50mm fashion editorial lens"}, square 1:1 crop, centered composition, no text, no logos, no watermark.

Goal: Create a side-by-side comparison graphic demonstrating global illumination / indirect bounce lighting improvement on the same anime illustration.

Canvas: Wide 16:9 horizontal image, split exactly into two equal vertical panels with a thin white divider line down the center. Use a soft pastel anime illustration style with dreamy morning light.

Layout: The left panel is labeled “Before” at the top-left and shows the normal version; the right panel is labeled “After” at the top-right and shows the enhanced version with warmer indirect light, natural contact shadows, and soft glow wrapping around the subject. Add a large centered headline across the top reading {argument name="headline text" default="プロンプト比較：光の回り込みGI"}. Add bottom-left Japanese label {argument name="left bottom label" default="通常生成"} on the left panel and bottom-right Japanese label {argument name="right bottom label" default="光の回り込みGI"} on the right panel. All overlay text is bold white with a dark drop shadow for readability.

Subject details: Show the same androgynous anime boy in both panels, seated indoors in a cozy bedroom by a bright window. He has fluffy layered {argument name="hair color" default="white-silver"} hair with lavender shadows, pale skin, and a slim elegant build. His face is intentionally covered by one large opaque pale mauve square censor block centered over the face in each panel; use exactly 2 censor blocks total, one per panel. His right hand rests near his cheek, partially visible beside the censor block. He wears a luxurious white robe or kimono-like top with navy-blue inner layers and wide sleeves, trimmed with metallic silver edges, decorated with star and crescent moon motifs. Include a crescent moon pendant necklace with a dangling blue gemstone.

Background details: The room contains exactly 1 large window visible behind the subject, soft curtains, a bed or cushioned seat, a small shelf or windowsill with perfume bottles and ornaments, and exactly 1 hanging crescent-moon decoration on each panel. The palette is lavender, white, pale blue, and warm sunlight.

Lighting comparison: Left “Before” panel should look flatter and cooler, with less bounce light and weaker shadows. Right “After” panel should visibly improve depth: add soft global illumination, warm sunlight wrapping around hair, face area, hands, robe folds, and shoulders; add subtle contact shadows where the hand touches the face area and where sleeves overlap; add bloom near the window and brighter rim light on the hair. Keep the character pose and composition identical between panels.

Constraints: Countable elements must remain exact: 2 comparison panels, 1 vertical divider, 4 text labels total, 2 face censor blocks, and 2 hanging crescent decorations. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional panels.

Goal: Create a polished Japanese proposal-style idea sheet for a casual mobile puzzle game where players collect 3 matching pies to clear them, titled {argument name="headline text" default="パイを3つ集めて消す カジュアルゲーム 4テーマ案"}. The sheet should look like a cheerful game design concept board, with cute UI mockups and explanatory diagrams.

Canvas: Wide landscape 16:9 presentation sheet, warm cream background, thin rounded border, tiny sparkles and dessert decorations. Use a soft pastel kawaii illustration style with clean vector-like edges, subtle shadows, glossy game UI highlights, and high readability.

Layout: Divide the canvas into exactly 4 large rounded theme panels arranged in a 2×2 grid. A prompt to generate a still image of a scene from an "old memory playing in the mind."

Texture DNA:
- Not a photo or a film, but a single frame freezing a moment from a recollected mental image.
- Ambiguous focus where outlines softly melt away.
- Blurred light (halation, lens flare, sunlight through trees).
- Faded colors with only one specific part appearing strangely vivid (red, sunset orange, summer green).
- Soft vignetting where edges fall into darkness.
- Mid-range framing as if time has stopped.
- Leaving an aura in the composition of "something is about to happen / something is ending."

## Output Rules (For Image2)

[Absolute Rules for Memory Texture]
- Focus: The subject is softly in focus, but the outline melts into the air. Sharpness is strictly prohibited.
- Light: Must include strong backlighting, side lighting, sunlight through trees, halation, or lens flare. The light source side should blur into white.
- Color: Overall faded feel. After desaturating, leave one specific color strong (sunset orange, deep summer green, a red school bag, water cyan, etc.).
- Grain: Apply a light, organic film grain across the whole frame.
- Vignette: Soft vignette where the four corners fall into darkness.
- Atmosphere: Enclose the feeling that "air is there" with floating particles like fine dust, pollen, water spray, or snow.
- Stillness: Depict the whole frame as if filled with a "silence where sound has faded away."

[Composition]
- Framing is mid-range (bust-up to full body). Avoid extreme close-ups or extreme wide shots.
- The subject is slightly offset from the center. No perfect centering.
- Camera height is at the eye level of the subject remembering the scene.
- Leave an aura of "something about to happen / ending" in the composition (a pause before movement, not a completed pose).
- Horizontal level is slightly tilted by 2 to 5 degrees.
- The subject's gaze is almost toward the camera but doesn't perfectly meet it (memories never look you in the eye).

[Historical Accuracy]
- Match clothing, hairstyle, accessories, architecture, signs, cars, and electronics to the specified era.
- Absolutely no modern smartphones, LED lights, electric cars, or modern brand logos.
- Streetscapes should be Japanese scenery from the specified era. No foreign or fantasy styles.

[Trademark Avoidance]
- All logos, signs, product packaging, brand tags, car emblems, and electronic logos are fictional and original.
- Never output real brand names, corporate logos, real product names, real celebrities' faces, or real characters.
- Text should only be fictional names or coined words. Faded or illegible text is also acceptable.

[Absolute Prohibitions]
- Photographic sharpness, HDR, modern high-resolution feel, 4K feel, or smartphone photo feel.
- Perfect focus, perfect leveling, or studio-lighting cleanliness.
- Posed smiles, poses, looking directly at the camera, or SNS profile picture compositions.
- White borders on photos, date stamps, or camera UI (as this is a frame of a mental image, not a physical photograph).
- Collages, splits, or multiple parallel frames. Always output as a single continuous image.
